adjudication.rationale: In the newly added API route `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` is called without a try/catch, and `JSON.parse(symmetricDecrypt(...))` is also unguarded. Both can throw on malformed input (invalid/missing fields, bad ciphertext, wrong `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, or non-JSON plaintext), which would cause Next.js to return a generic 500 response instead of the structured 4xx JSON responses used elsewhere in the handler (e.g., invalid secret/user/app).
